about: Where each bound key acts, per JAR evidence (NeoForge 21.1.249, 316-mod client of 2026-09-24). default = binding with no pack preset. Used by tools/check_keybinds.py.

contexts.world: In the world with no screen open.
contexts.screen:<id>: Only inside that screen; screenParents lists the container screens.
contexts.hover: Acts only on what is under the cursor; different targets never meet, except slot (any item).

gates: A world key that only acts while holding (held:), riding (riding:) or holding another key (hold:). Two different held: gates never meet in one hand; other gates can meet. gateInContext: the KeyConflictContext itself is inactive outside the gate, so it cannot hide another key there.

key.keyboard.g.reason: Curios screen: Terra Arm and the Ultimine curio live there.

key.keyboard.v.reason: Held while mining, also while sneaking.

protectedAbout: Fixed owners chosen by Elias. Nothing else may use these letters with Shift or Ctrl in the world: sneaking or holding sprint would hide the owner behind the combination.

exclusiveGates.reason: Ultimine shapes change only while V is held to mine; LittleTiles rotates only with its tool in hand.

aliases.reason: Bumblezone reuses jump to climb while riding a Beehemoth.
PneumaticCraft jet boots fire with the jump key by design.
Gravitite armor boosts the normal jump.
Both extend the jump key; each needs its own armor piece.
Both extend the jump key; one only while riding a Beehemoth.
Both extend the jump key; one only while riding a Beehemoth.

Trading screen only, and Silent Gear only with one of its items under the cursor; both are the mods own defaults. Rare: C over a Silent Gear item while trading.
